name: Song of the Crimson Nile
source:
Disease ravages Upper Egypt – the dark curse, as they call it. The Pharaoh’s squad believes dark magic is to blame. 

Can you work among them while keeping your identity as a dark magician a secret?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Song_of_the_Crimson_Nile]romance-club.fandom[/url]
